summary: This is a bash script that defines a library of console output functions for printing colored text and handling user interaction. The functions are named using a namespace convention (console::) to organize them logically, though they're all currently empty stubs waiting to be implemented.

explanations.1: This shebang line tells the system to execute this script using bash, found wherever it's installed on the system (via the env command), rather than assuming it's in a specific location.
explanations.3: The function keyword creates a reusable block of code named console::askYesNo (the double colon is just part of the function name, acting as a namespace separator for organization).
